newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Aussie Home Loans cuts business loan rate by 0.5 p.
newsitem.headline: Aussie Home Loans cuts business loan rate by 0.5 p.

text.p: Aussie Home Loans said on Wednesday it has cut its Aussie Business Loans standard variable rate by 0.5 percent to 6.49 percent in response to the latest cut in official cash rates by the Reserve Bank of Australia.
Aussie Home Loans said the cut would be effective from Thursday for new customers, but existing customers would have to wait until September 23 for it to take effect.
"Aussie Business Loans' new standard variable rate is now the lowest standard business rate by any major lender in Australia," Aussie Home Loans, managing director, John Symond said.

"Our rate drop will be welcomed by every small business in Australia, giving them confidence to invest, expand and employ Australia's central bank earlier on Wednesday eased monetary policy with a 0.5 percentage point cut in official rates to 5.0 percent, the fifth cut in a year.
